system.name: spectre-app
system.summary: Application manifest for this Spectre-scaffolded project.

foundation.title: Foundation
foundation.description: Published Spectre packages this app consumes as external dependencies.

@phcdevworks/spectre-tokens.description: Design tokens as CSS variables and JS objects.

@phcdevworks/spectre-ui.description: CSS bundles and type-safe recipe functions built on tokens.

@phcdevworks/spectre-ui-astro.description: SSR-safe Astro components built on spectre-ui recipes.

generationRules: Consume Spectre UI through @phcdevworks/spectre-ui-astro components — do not hand-roll markup against spectre-ui recipes directly.
usageGuidance: This manifest describes this app's own Spectre dependencies. It is a starting point, not a registration in the Spectre ecosystem manifest.
safeDefaults: Keep the "spectre-app" package entry's dependencies list in sync with package.json's @phcdevworks/* dependencies.
